basics.name: Renzil D'Souza
basics.label: Entrepreneur
basics.summary:
I have 17+ years of software engineering and management experience, most recently as a founding engineer of Slixta [https://slixta.com] - a SaaS marketing automation platform. I'm passionate about building delightful products, marketing and selling them, and in the process growing high-performing teams.

At Adobe, my teams have built multiple ver1.0 desktop (Win/Mac) apps with backend services. I am a former recipient of the Adobe Outstanding Young Engineer Award.

As an entrepreneur I have dabbled in marketing and design consulting, and built commercial chatbots. I have also helped students discover opportunities in tech.

portfolio.headline: Hi, I’m Renzil.
portfolio.intro: Founding engineer with 17+ years of experience building products, teams, and businesses. I turn ambiguous problems into working software, own architecture and production, and stay close to customers from MVP to scale.
portfolio.contactIntro: I’m open to conversations about founding-engineer and senior engineering roles, or ambitious products that need a technical partner.

work.summary: Founding engineer of a SaaS marketing automation platform
highlights: Architected and built core product systems including a full-featured CRM, email and WhatsApp campaigns, workflow automations and AI-powered content generation
Work directly with enterprise customers and manage customer success for deployments with hundreds of daily active users
Own architecture, reliability and production operations for a multi-tenant SaaS platform processing millions of daily transactions across thousands of users

work.summary: Building products, consulting, and experimenting across technology and business
highlights: Software engineering consulting for multiple early stage startups
Teaching students to build production websites and helping them discover opportunities in tech
Built commercial chatbots using Python, Rasa, Docker and DigitalOcean
Built a website to find a hospital bed during the Covid emergency
Market validation for a sustainable apparel idea through Google and Facebook ads

awards.title: Synthesis of Composite Images Having Virtual Backgrounds (US10621777B2)
awards.summary: A method for separating a person from the original background and placing them into a new virtual background in real time.

awards.title: Removing Overlays from a Screen to Separately Record Screens and Overlays in a Digital Medium Environment (US10546557B2)
awards.summary: A way to record a screen and its overlays separately, so controls and annotations can be removed or edited without losing the original screen content.

awards.title: Method and apparatus for real-time matting using local color estimation and propagation (US9786055B1)
awards.summary: A real-time technique for separating foreground subjects from their background, including fine details such as hair, to create cleaner composites.

awards.title: Outstanding Young Engineer 2016
awards.summary: Outstanding Young Engineers Award is given by Adobe India to a select few (3-4) annually across India to recognize outstanding contributions to engineering.
